card.title: Count What I Did
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I spent my Saturday fixing your fence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three panels, eighteen screws, two shops and one blister.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll recommend you to next door. They've got six panels.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them three took my whole Saturday before you make me sound available for Sunday.

mechanism: A counters a minimized fence repair with time, supplies and bodily cost so future praise does not erase the work.
confusable: Unlike advertising skill, A must get B to recognize the inconvenience and duration of the contribution.
comparison: D33-b conditions a recommendation on accurate time cost; D33-a conditions the meaning of rest on knowing the second trip.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
